title: Rafael and the Songbook
author: Mara Dravenmoor
blurb: Sable Ashgrove, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
